solidarityRate.note: taxa adicional de solidariedade on rendimento coletável above 80,000 (2.5%) and above 250,000 (an additional 2.5%, i.e. 5% total) — Continente/Madeira. VERIFY exact Açores rates (spec cites 1.75%/3.5% for Açores) against the official text before this ships.

deductions.note: Taken from SALARY_CALCULATOR_SPEC.md §6 deduções à coleta (v1 subset). The spec gives the taxpayer's own disability deduction ONLY for a non-married taxpayer (2,148.52) and a separate figure for a dependent who has a disability (1,342.83) — it does NOT give a figure for a MARRIED taxpayer's own disability; that case is deliberately not implemented in the engine rather than guessed, flagged there as a real gap. mínimo de existência (2026 reference €12,880/year) is flagged VERIFY in the spec and not yet implemented either. VERIFY every value here against CIRS before this ships to real users.
